title: VLSU: MAPPING THE LIMITS OF JOINT MULTIMODAL UNDERSTANDING FOR AI SAFETY
reasoning: The paper introduces the VLSU benchmark to evaluate the safety of vision-language models across 15 harm categories such as violence, terrorism, and self-harm. While it addresses 'discrimination' as a subset of safety, the work is centered on technical safety alignment and multimodal reasoning failures rather than an evaluation of religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical systems.
